retrievalProfile.description: A centered cinematic portrait framed by thick tan borders containing ultra-condensed, wide-tracked typography in the corners.
triggerTerms: desert car portrait with tan borders

recipe.visualDefinition: A central rectangular photograph of a man in a denim shirt sitting in a vintage convertible, set against a desert backdrop, framed by a thick, textured tan border that holds four distinct blocks of text in each corner.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetrical text placement in all four corners of the border
Contrast between the warm tan frame and the cool blue denim
Horizontal division between the image and the top/bottom border areas
Visual weight balanced by the subject's arms extending toward the frame edges
coreInvariants: Thick tan or beige border framing a central image
Extreme letter spacing (tracking) in all text blocks

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered, waist-up, occupying the middle 60% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the dark hair provide the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top-left text, move to the subject's face, then scan the remaining corners clockwise.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space provided by the thick tan borders and the open desert sky.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Desaturated, earthy tones with high value in the sky and border.

letterConstructionRules: Extremely high aspect ratio (tall and narrow)
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used across all four corners for absolute symmetry.
graphicDevices: Subtle grain texture on the border

avoid: Centered text within the image area

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the extreme verticality and clean sans-serif terminals.
Provides the necessary uppercase impact and clean lines.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a cinematic photo of a man in a denim shirt sitting in a vintage convertible in a desert, then place it inside a thick tan rectangular frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add ultra-condensed black sans-serif text in all four corners of the tan frame with wide letter spacing.

verificationChecks: Is the text in all four corners?
Is there a thick tan border framing the image?
Is the tracking wide enough to create a rhythmic feel?

mustRedesign: Any text overlapping the central image

mustAchieve: Consistent border width on all sides

postGenerationChecks: Check that text does not touch the image edge
Verify the tan border has a subtle paper-like texture
Ensure the subject is looking slightly away from the camera
Confirm all four text blocks are the same font and size
recipe.reuseFormula: Cinematic portrait + thick textured border + 4-corner condensed typography.
